# Inn-Salzach Massivbau GmbH

> > Regional Town & Country Haus partner specializing in solid construction single-family homes, bungalows, and multi-family houses with customizable floor plans.

Inn-Salzach Massivbau GmbH is a licensed Town & Country Haus partner offering turnkey solid construction homes in the Inn-Salzach region. The company provides a range of house models including the Flair, Raumwunder, Bungalow, and Mitwachshaus series, with options for energy-efficient and eco-friendly building.

## Key Topics

- Town & Country Haus
- Massivbau (solid construction)
- Einfamilienhaus (single-family homes)
- Bungalow models
- Flair series (Flair 125, 134, 148, 110, 113)
- Raumwunder series (90, 100)
- Mehrfamilienhaus (multi-family houses)
- Schlüsselfertig (turnkey homes)
- Energiesparhaus (energy-efficient homes)
- Hausausstellung (house exhibition)
- Bauplanung (construction planning)
- Mitwachshaus (growing homes)
- Stadthaus (city houses)
- Eigenheim (homeownership)
- Ökobilanz (ecological balance)
